name: Hex
description: The family sheepdog who leads Kellan to a portal.

description_citations.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
description_citations.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: On a new-moon night Kellan races Hex to the willow tree and sees a translucent archway to the faerie realm.
timeline.quote: Ahead of him there is an archway made of ethereal, translucent stone.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan returns home to Orrinshire and is reunited with Hex, Ronald and his mother, who gives him an enchanted coat.
timeline.quote: yes, after all of that, he is finally home.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Hex leads Kellan to a swirling portal in the woods and Kellan steps through, hoping to find his father.
timeline.quote: Kellan pets Hex, and steps through the portal.
